The department network

Movement of undergraduates between intended major (at application), declared major, and degree earned, drawn as a graph over all 79 departments. Every figure is distinct students: each cell of the underlying matrices counts a student at most once, and the ring around each node is head-over-head — the share of the unit's own students who continue in it.

About these data

Source and grain. UC Berkeley OPAP's public Major Migration dashboard (calviz.berkeley.edu), harvested through its view-export channel as head-count matrices: intended × declared and intended × degree at department grain, and declared × degree from the department pathway tensor summed over the intended axis only. Each matrix cell counts a student at most once — intended major is single-valued, so a cell is “distinct students who intended X and ended in Y.”

What can and cannot be summed. A student with two declared majors appears once in each major's node, so node values are honest but nodes do not sum to the entering class, and a student who left one department for two others is counted on both corridors. Departure and arrival totals are therefore corridor totals, and are labeled as such. Rings never mix grains: each is the unit's diagonal over its own distinct-student marginal.

Two independent harvests agree exactly. The per-cohort layer comes from a 2026-07-04 scrape of the dashboard's drill-down states; the era frames come from the 2026-08-01 pin/matrix tensor harvest — two separately written extractors on two different dashboard channels. Compared cell by cell (30 of 30 frame × leg comparisons, ~48,000 cells), they agree with zero disagreements, and the build re-runs that comparison as an assertion.

Censoring. Recent cohorts have not had time to finish: degree-stage views are suppressed for freshman cohorts after 2021 and transfer cohorts after 2022, and flagged ⚠ where partly observable. The 2023 transfer declared-stage view is a dashboard artifact and is flagged. The College of Computing, Data Science & Society (est. 2023) is retroactively assigned by the dashboard, so earlier-cohort CDSS flows reflect reclassified majors.
